caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair placed centrally against a plain, off-white background. The chair is shown from the front and features three horizontal slats on the backrest, each made of polished brown wood. The top of each vertical post on the backrest is adorned with a small finial. The seat is woven, likely from straw or rush, displaying a light tan color with visible texture. The chair frame, including the legs and supports, is constructed from the same brown wood as the back slats. The structure includes two side stretchers connecting the legs, with additional crossbars for further support. The perspective is symmetrical, and the entire object is rendered with attention to the wood grain and material detail, giving a clear, realistic view of its composition. Minimal text and markings are present at the bottom right and lower edge of the page.
title: Ladder Rock Chair
